rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR LOWER EXTREMITY MAGNETIC RESONANCE ANGIOGRAPHY (MRA) / Peripheral Arterial Disease
rules.source_quote: For known or suspected atherosclerotic peripheral arterial disease when any ONE of the following non-invasive studies are abnormal or indeterminate

criteria.description: Known or suspected atherosclerotic peripheral arterial disease of the lower extremities
Prior non-invasive vascular study (ankle-brachial index, segmental pressures, or pulse volume recording) is abnormal or indeterminate

required_documentation: Vascular lab report showing abnormal ABI (< 0.9) or pulse volume recordings
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic prerequisite non-invasive vascular testing prior to lower extremity MRA.
